options.content:
Ziel: Last- und Temperaturmuster in Frankreich, Deutschland/Luxemburg, Spanien und Italien auswerten und gegen den gleichen Kalenderzeitraum 2025 spiegeln.

Hauptmessage: Der Cooling-Load-Kanal ist in Frankreich und Italien deutlich sichtbar, in Spanien zwar hoch, aber im gleichen Kalenderfenster 2025 ebenfalls stark, und in Deutschland/Luxemburg moderater.

**Datenbasis:** Datenfluss: Rohdaten wurden mit `scripts/research_heatwave_2026.py` aus ENTSO-E Transparency, Energy-Charts/SMARD-Fallback fuer DE_LU-Preise und Open-Meteo geladen. Preise bleiben als `prices_qh` in 15-Minuten-Aufloesung erhalten; Last, Erzeugung, Fluesse und Wetter werden als Stundenkontext in `Europe/Brussels` normalisiert, als CSV gecacht und mit `scripts/load_heatwave_2026_to_postgres.py` in das OEDS-Postgres-Schema `heatwave_2026` geladen. Grafana fragt diese Tabellen direkt per SQL ab; Zeitbereich und Variablen werden live in der Query angewendet. Standard-Zeitfenster: 2026-06-01 00:00 bis 2026-06-30 23:00 Europe/Brussels; Hitzewellenfenster: 2026-06-13 00:00 bis 2026-06-29 23:00 Europe/Brussels; Baseline fuer voraggregierte Delta-Metriken: 2026-06-01 00:00 bis 2026-06-12 23:00 Europe/Brussels.

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.load_temperature_h`. ENTSO-E Actual Total Load wurde stundenweise gemittelt und mit Open-Meteo 2m-Temperatur fuer Paris, Berlin, Madrid und Rom verbunden. Angezeigt werden 2026-Stundenwerte fuer den Grafana-Zeitbereich und `load_country`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       label || ' load GW' AS metric,
       load_mw / 1000.0 AS value
FROM heatwave_2026.load_temperature_h
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND year = 2026
  AND country IN (${load_country:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Hourly load

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.load_temperature_daily`. Berechnung: Tagesmittel der Open-Meteo-2m-Temperatur fuer eine repraesentative Stadt je Land. Das ist ein Cooling-Load-Proxy, keine flaechengenaue nationale Temperatur.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels' AS time,
       label || ' temp C' AS metric,
       temp_avg_c AS value
FROM heatwave_2026.load_temperature_daily
WHERE year = 2026
  AND date >= ($__timeFrom()::date)
  AND date < ($__timeTo()::date)
  AND country IN (${load_country:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Daily average temperature

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.load_temperature_daily`. Berechnung: Tagesmittel der stundenweisen ENTSO-E-Last je Land. Die Zeitreihe zeigt die Juni-2026-Last und reagiert auf `load_country`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels' AS time,
       label || ' daily load GW' AS metric,
       load_avg_mw / 1000.0 AS value
FROM heatwave_2026.load_temperature_daily
WHERE year = 2026
  AND date >= ($__timeFrom()::date)
  AND date < ($__timeTo()::date)
  AND country IN (${load_country:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Daily average load

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.load_temperature_h`. Berechnung: lokale Stundenmittel nach Land, Jahr und Fenster. 2026 Hitzewelle = 13.-29.06.; 2026 Nicht-Hitzewelle = 01.-12.06. plus 30.06.; 2025 = gleicher Kalenderzeitraum 13.-29.06.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT make_timestamptz(2026, 6, 1, hour::int, 0, 0, 'Europe/Brussels') AS time,
       label || ' ' || year::text || ' ' ||
       CASE WHEN period = 'event_window' THEN 'event' ELSE 'baseline' END AS metric,
       avg(load_mw) / 1000.0 AS value
FROM heatwave_2026.load_temperature_h
WHERE country IN (${load_country:sqlstring})
  AND (
      (year = 2026 AND period IN ('event_window', 'non_heatwave'))
      OR (year = 2025 AND period = 'event_window')
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Load profile heatwave baseline previous year

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.load_temperature_deltas`. Berechnung: Eventfenster minus Nicht-Hitzewellen-Baseline je Jahr und Daypart. Dayparts: all day, midday 11:00-15:00, evening 18:00-22:00.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label,
       max(delta_load_avg_mw) FILTER (WHERE year = 2026 AND daypart = 'all_day') / 1000.0 AS "2026 all-day GW",
       max(delta_load_avg_mw) FILTER (WHERE year = 2026 AND daypart = 'midday_11_15') / 1000.0 AS "2026 midday GW",
       max(delta_load_avg_mw) FILTER (WHERE year = 2026 AND daypart = 'evening_18_22') / 1000.0 AS "2026 evening GW",
       max(delta_load_avg_mw) FILTER (WHERE year = 2025 AND daypart = 'all_day') / 1000.0 AS "2025 all-day GW",
       max(delta_load_avg_mw) FILTER (WHERE year = 2025 AND daypart = 'midday_11_15') / 1000.0 AS "2025 midday GW",
       max(delta_load_avg_mw) FILTER (WHERE year = 2025 AND daypart = 'evening_18_22') / 1000.0 AS "2025 evening GW"
FROM heatwave_2026.load_temperature_deltas
WHERE country IN (${load_country:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Load delta by daypart

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.load_temperature_yoy`. Berechnung: mittlere Last 13.-29.06.2026 minus mittlere Last 13.-29.06.2025 je Land und Daypart, als Prozent und MW. Kontrolliert grob fuer Saison, nicht fuer Feiertage, Wochentage oder Strukturwandel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label,
       max(delta_yoy_pct) FILTER (WHERE daypart = 'all_day') AS "all-day %",
       max(delta_yoy_pct) FILTER (WHERE daypart = 'midday_11_15') AS "midday %",
       max(delta_yoy_pct) FILTER (WHERE daypart = 'evening_18_22') AS "evening %"
FROM heatwave_2026.load_temperature_yoy
WHERE country IN (${load_country:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Year-on-year load comparison

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.load_temperature_deltas`. Berechnung: 2026 Hitzewelle minus Nicht-Hitzewellen-Baseline fuer Last, Temperatur und Cooling-degree-hours ueber 22 C. Fokus auf all-day, midday und evening.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label,
       year,
       daypart,
       round((delta_load_avg_mw / 1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS delta_load_gw,
       round(delta_load_pct::numeric, 1) AS delta_load_pct,
       round(delta_temp_avg_c::numeric, 1) AS delta_temp_c,
       round(delta_cdd22_sum::numeric, 1) AS delta_cdd22_sum,
       round((event_load_avg_mw / 1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS event_load_gw,
       round(event_temp_avg_c::numeric, 1) AS event_temp_c
FROM heatwave_2026.load_temperature_deltas
WHERE country IN (${load_country:sqlstring})
ORDER BY label, year, daypart

panels.title: Cooling-load summary

panels.description: Quellen: `heatwave_2026.load_temperature_summary`, `load_temperature_deltas` und `load_temperature_yoy`. Die Tabellen sind aus ENTSO-E Actual Total Load und Open-Meteo-Stadtproxytemperaturen abgeleitet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label,
       daypart,
       round((load_2025_mw / 1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS load_2025_gw,
       round((load_2026_mw / 1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS load_2026_gw,
       round((delta_yoy_mw / 1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS delta_yoy_gw,
       round(delta_yoy_pct::numeric, 1) AS delta_yoy_pct,
       round(temp_2025_c::numeric, 1) AS temp_2025_c,
       round(temp_2026_c::numeric, 1) AS temp_2026_c,
       round(delta_temp_yoy_c::numeric, 1) AS delta_temp_yoy_c
FROM heatwave_2026.load_temperature_yoy
WHERE country IN (${load_country:sqlstring})
ORDER BY label, daypart
